stem: 根据美国金融犯罪执法网络(FinCEN)的规定,银行账户中的哪些警示信号综合起来可能表明存在现代奴役、人口贩运和剥削行为？(选择两项.)

options.A: 来自第三方支付处理商的资金转入，且附带的汇款人信息有限
options.B: 与注册虚拟货币交易所进行的交易活动
options.C: 向农业流动工人支付大量现金
options.D: 频繁支付在线广告或非本地分类广告费用

stem_en: According to FinCEN, which red flags within a bank account may, taken together, be indications of modern slavery, human trafficking, and exploitation? (Select two.)

options_en.A: Incoming fund transfers from third-party payment processors with limited originator information
options_en.B: Transactional activity with a registered virtual currency exchange
options_en.C: Large amounts of cash payments to migrant agricultural workers
options_en.D: Frequent payments for online advertisements or non-local classified ads
